```yaml
name: Auto Approve Copilot Workflows

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: taiki-e/checkout-action@83ed61bfbe2b8abbb3c66e8b65b1335484c70009

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Build project
        run: go build ./...

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.out
          directory: .

  approve-copilot-workflows:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.actor == 'copilot-actions[bot]' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'

    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous workflow runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          message: "All tests passed successfully! 🎉"
```
